title: Heat alerts: 6-agent audit
story: Six agents, five tools, a nested sensor-reliability sub-investigation and one contained fault. Capability 2/4 reflects a known trajectory-judge sensitivity, not a bad run.
description: A six-agent audit of a heat-alert policy across two neighborhoods: a coordinator delegates to data, policy, sensor-health, statistician and equity-reviewer agents, with one contained tool fault. Multi-agent, text only.
